name: @pipeworx/mcp-rhode-island-code

tools.name: ri_general_law
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Rhode Island General Laws — Rhode Island state law — by citation. "R.I. Gen. Laws 11-23-1" is murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Rhode Island General Laws 11-23-1 say" or to check an RI statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "11-23-1" (murder) or "31-27-2" (DUI). Title-chapter-section.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-rhode-island-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the rhode-island-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
